fees.title: Fees
fees.intro: Every fee and discount on Capimax RT, with the rates in force today. The amounts are always shown before you confirm.
fees.note: Rates are set by Capimax RT and can change; a change never applies to purchases or installment plans already made. Payment providers (card, crypto, bank) may charge their own fees.

purchase.name: Purchase fee
purchase.when: On buying shares (on the share amount)

installment.name: Installment fee
installment.who: The buyer on an installment plan
installment.when: On the down payment and every installment

resale.name: Secondary market fee
resale.who: The buyer (the seller receives the full price)

reinvest.name: Reinvest discount
reinvest.when: On the share price; no purchase fee
